meta.purpose: Coordinate cooperating agents that edit the same analyzed repository without serializing read-only SAGE inspection.

scope.guarantee: Coordinates agents that use the same SAGE target-analysis database. It does not claim a distributed filesystem lock across disconnected SAGE installations.
scope.read_only_behavior: Parallel-safe; inspection, graph queries, and packet reads do not acquire a write lease.

steps: Acquire a target write lease after selecting one grounded target file.
Validate the proposed bounded patch while the lease is active.
Apply the patch outside SAGE only after validation passes and required human approval is present.
Release the lease immediately after the external write attempt, whether it succeeds or fails.
Refresh or wait for the watchdog/source snapshot before using a pre-write packet for a subsequent mutation.
agent_protocol.busy_instruction: Do not edit the target file. Wait until retry_after_seconds, then reacquire and refresh source grounding before retrying.
